publication: Yong Cheng, Effective inseparability and some applications in meta-mathematics, arXiv:2210.17333v3 dated 2023-04-09; journal version Journal of Logic and Computation 34(6), 2024, 1010–1031. The arXiv v3 HTML is the inspected version.

reviews.checked_passages: Root source selection 2026-11-09: Definition1.1, Example2.2, the effective-inseparability, pair-reduction and universality clauses of Definition2.3, Proposition2.5/selected Theorem2.7 preimage argument, and full Theorems2.11–2.15 including Lemma2.12 and their case analyses.
reviews.consumers: effective-inseparability, especially diagonal-effective-pair, simultaneous-self-reference, upward-transfer, universal-effective-pairs and characterization.
reviews.outcome: The corpus directly derives simultaneous domain self-reference from the existing one-master-program theorem; it does not assume the strong double recursion theorem. Its direct singleton-enlargement proof expands the selected universal-pair reasoning with actual numerical compilers and the neither-side case. CHENG-EI-01 is an adjacent local variable slip; no use of the unselected metamathematical applications or the full diagram of equivalences is claimed.
